newsitem.title: NORWAY: First gas from Norway's Heidrun delayed - Statoil.
newsitem.headline: First gas from Norway's Heidrun delayed - Statoil.

text.p: First gas from the Heidrun field in the Norwegian Sea has been delayed by about one week, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap said on Thursday.
Gas was due to begin flowing to the Tjeldbergodden methanol plant in mid-Norway on Wednesday.
During testing a leaking seal was discovered in a valve at the receiving station at the end of the Haltenpipe line, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Work was underway to replace the seal and begin gas deliveries.
Statoil said the delay would not affect the start of methanol production at Tjeldbergodden, which is scheduled to come onstream on April 1, 1997.
